biggest_catch: Fees reset every calendar quarter — a strong quarter gets you Level 3 pricing, but a slow quarter drops you back to Level 1 with no warning.
catches: Level 1 (new sellers): 9.0% transaction fee; higher quarterly volume unlocks Level 2–5 (8.5%–7.0% transaction).
Level 3–5 sellers who fail to ship 5%+ of orders in a month face a penalty fee the following month for each unfulfilled sale.
Quarterly reset (Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1); once you achieve a level you keep its benefits for the current quarter and the following quarter.
Items must be new and pass StockX verification — a failed sale is void, not just fee-reduced.
Visa debit payouts cost a debit fee ($1.95–$9.95); use bank transfer instead.

s6.note: 5 steps: list ask, bid match, ship for authentication, verification, payout.

steps: List your new item at an ask price (or accept a bid)
When your ask matches a buyer's bid, the sale executes automatically
Ship the item to StockX with their UPS label for authentication
StockX authenticates and delivers to the buyer
Receive payout (bank transfer, PayPal, Venmo, or debit) minus the tiered transaction fee
timing: Paid after authentication; quarterly tier resets Jan 1/Apr 1/Jul 1/Oct 1
who_pays: The buyer pays through StockX, and StockX pays you after your item passes its authentication.
who_qualifies: Anyone 18+; items must be brand new and pass StockX verification.
work_available: StockX is active and open to new sellers — seller levels reset quarterly (Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1).
what_gets_accepted: Items must be new and pass StockX's authentication — a failed sale is void. Higher quarterly volume unlocks lower fee levels (Levels 2–5), but sellers at Levels 3–5 who fail to ship 5%+ of orders in a month face a penalty fee the next month.
costs_and_unpaid_time: New sellers (Level 1) pay a 9.0% transaction fee; higher volume drops it to 8.5%–7.0%. Visa debit payouts cost $1.95–$9.95 — use bank transfer instead. Unpaid time goes to listing and shipping the item to StockX for authentication.
when_cash_arrives: After your item passes authentication, StockX releases your payout — via bank transfer (free) or debit card (fee applies).
